text: The Patriots' organizational strains continue to mount as Greg Van Roten joins the injured reserve list with a thigh injury, further compromising Drake Maye's offensive infrastructure at a moment when the quarterback's early-season performance demands stability rather than disruption. Maye himself acknowledged the dire circumstances following Sunday's 35-6 obliteration at the hands of the Jaguars—a loss in which he threw two interceptions and fumbled once while New England managed a league-worst 9.7 offensive points per game—calling both his own play and the offense's overall execution "unacceptable," though several analysts have questioned whether the system itself bears some responsibility for his struggles. With the Bills awaiting the Patriots in Buffalo on Sunday at 1 PM ET, the question looming over Highmark Stadium is whether this weekend provides a reset moment or another data point in what's becoming an uncomfortably familiar pattern of offensive dysfunction.
